PROMISSORY NOTE AND LOAN AGREEMENT

This Loan Agreement ("Agreement") is executed between Summit Capital ("Lender") and Horizon LLC ("Borrower").

SECTION 1. PRINCIPAL AMOUNT
Lender agrees to loan Borrower the principal sum of One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000.00 USD).

SECTION 2. INTEREST RATE (SECTION 2)
The unpaid principal balance shall accrue simple interest at a fixed rate of 5.0% per annum, payable in equal monthly installments.

SECTION 3. DEFAULT & IMMEDIATE ACCELERATION
Upon any payment failure exceeding 10 days, Lender may immediately declare the entire unpaid principal balance instantly due and payable without cure notice.

SECTION 4. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Lender's liability for any operational loss or delay in funding shall be limited exclusively to $500 USD.

SECTION 5. DEFAULT INTEREST RATE (SECTION 5)
In the event of default or payment delay, the applicable interest rate on all outstanding balances shall automatically adjust to 18.0% per annum retroactive to loan origination.
